description: ReportIQ report fields for intake analyze and RAG (flat string key/value). Align with frontend/src/types/report.ts

conditionals.note: Relevant when how_aware is the 'other' option

ui_only: AI follow-up wizard (Generate AI follow-up, follow-up answers, RAG) is not represented as single fields; use reportiq_intake_analyze and RAG tools and merge results into form_data as the app would.

response_extraction.summary: LLM neutral summary, then merged: optional fallback from general_nature/when/where if empty; optional suffix Structured form context: When…; Where… when not redundant.
response_extraction.locations_mentioned: LLM plus where_occurred, incident_location, country when set
response_extraction.people_mentioned: LLM plus person_1..10 first+last when set
response_extraction.specific_examples_present: true if LLM or long sequence_of_events
response_extraction.evidence_described: true if LLM or (has_supporting_materials yes and long evidence_description)
response_extraction.timeline_clear: true if LLM or when/duration/sequence or long sequence_of_events
response_extraction.prior_reporting_mentioned: true if LLM or management_aware is yes

intake_analyze_and_feed_summary.follow_up_question_text: Comes from active gap templates (GET /api/intake/gaps). Persisted in backend data/settings.json in dev; reset via Admin or POST /api/admin/intake-gaps/reset to match code defaults if templates drift.
intake_analyze_and_feed_summary.feed_summary_tab: Submissions store extraction as returned by the last successful intake run; Summary matches this object plus followUpQuestions, policy from form, and a short merge note in the UI.
